title: When Simulation Lies: A Sim-to-Real Benchmark and Domain-Randomized RL Recipe for Tool-Use Agents
abstract: arXiv:2605.11928v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Tool-use language agents are evaluated on benchmarks that assume clean inputs, unambiguous tool registries, and reliable APIs. Real deployments violate all these assumptions: user typos propagate into hallucinated tool names, a misconfigured request timeout can stall an agent indefinitely, and duplicate tool names across servers can freeze an SDK. We study these failures as a sim-to-real gap in the tool-use partially observable Markov decision process (POMDP), where deployment noise enters through the observation, action space, reward-relevant metadata, or transition dynamics. We introduce RobustBench-TC, a benchmark with 22 perturbation types organized by these four POMDP components, each grounded in a verified GitHub issue or documented tool-calling failure. Across 21 models from 1.5B to 32B parameters (including the closed-source o4-mini), the robustness profile is sharply uneven: observation perturbations reduce accuracy by less

translated_title: 当模拟撒谎时：面向工具使用智能体的模拟到现实基准与域随机化强化学习方案
translated_abstract: 工具使用型语言智能体通常在假设输入干净、工具注册表无歧义且API可靠的基准上进行评估。然而真实部署环境违背了所有这些假设：用户的拼写错误会传播为幻觉出的工具名称，配置错误的请求超时可能导致智能体无限期停滞，跨服务器重复的工具名称可能使SDK冻结。我们将这些失效问题视为工具使用部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）中的模拟到现实差距，其中部署噪声通过观测、动作空间、奖励相关元数据或转移动力学进入系统。我们提出了RobustBench-TC基准，包含22种扰动类型并按这四个POMDP组件组织，每种扰动均基于经过验证的GitHub issue或有据可查的工具调用失效案例。在对参数规模从1.5B到32B的21个模型（包括闭源的o4-mini）的评估中，鲁棒性表现极不均衡：观测扰动使准确率下降……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了基于真实部署失效案例构建的RobustBench-TC基准，用以揭示工具使用智能体在模拟与真实环境之间严重不均衡的鲁棒性差距，并给出了域随机化强化学习训练方案以提升其现实部署可靠性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces RobustBench-TC, a benchmark of 22 perturbation types grounded in verified real-world tool-calling failures that exposes the sharply uneven sim-to-real robustness gap in tool-use agents, and provides a domain-randomized RL recipe to improve their deployment reliability.
